Package com.spaceinvaders.backend.auth

Class AuthenticationManager

java.lang.Object
com.spaceinvaders.backend.auth.AuthenticationManager
public class AuthenticationManager extends Object
AuthenticationManager.java
This class handles user authentication and session management by talking to the game server's HTTP API. (It originally signed users in through Firebase Authentication; the server now keeps its own accounts.) Key Features: - Signs users up and in, returning a session token. - Fetches the signed-in user's profile. - Performs the handshake that registers the client's UDP socket with a game world. Usage example: ``` String token = AuthenticationManager.signIn("pilot", "password123"); String killCount = AuthenticationManager.getUserData(token); ```
Since:
11/21/2024

  • Method Details

    • signIn

      public static String signIn(String email, String password) throws AuthenticationException
      Authenticates a user with the game server using their id and password.
      Parameters:
      email - The id (or email address) of the user attempting to sign in.
      password - The password associated with the user's id.
      Returns:
      A session token that can be passed to getUserData(String).
      Throws:
      AuthenticationException - If the response indicates authentication failure.

    • signUp

      public static void signUp(String email, String password, String confirmPassword) throws AuthenticationException
      Registers a new user with the provided id and password. This method ensures the password and confirm password match, and then asks the server to create the account.
      Parameters:
      email - The id (or email address) of the user to be registered.
      password - The password chosen by the user.
      confirmPassword - Confirmation of the password to ensure accuracy.
      Throws:
      AuthenticationException - If the input validation fails (e.g., taken id, mismatched passwords).

    • handshake

      public static int handshake(boolean multiplayer, int udpPort) throws AuthenticationException
      Asks the server to admit this client's UDP socket to a game world.
      Parameters:
      multiplayer - whether to join the shared multiplayer world (otherwise a private single player world is created)
      udpPort - the local port of the client's UDP socket
      Returns:
      the server UDP port of the game world to send input to
      Throws:
      AuthenticationException - if the server cannot be reached or refuses the request

    • resetPassword

      public static void resetPassword(String email) throws AuthenticationException
      Password reset used to send an email through Firebase. The self-hosted server has no mail service, so this always explains how to proceed instead.
      Parameters:
      email - The email address of the user requesting a password reset.
      Throws:
      AuthenticationException - always, with a message for the user
